https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: extraordinary redemption provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheduled date for the first regular coupon payment, in a regular repeating series of coupon periods, after any non standard (long or short) first coupon period in the schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: first regular coupon date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond whose coupon rate and principal amount are fixed at the time of origination or sale and remain constant while the security is outstanding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed coupon bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms for payment of interest on a bond with a fixed interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed coupon terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond with a variable interest rate based on a published reference interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: floating rate note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond secured by an unconditional promise to pay by another entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: full faith credit bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipal bond that is backed by the full faith and credit and general resources of the issuing municipality, including its general taxing authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: general obligation municipal bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt security issued by a government to fund government spending
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt security issued by some government on behalf of some polity, including sovereign and municipal debt
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government issued debt security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued specifically to fund climate or environmental projects
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: green bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued by a government sponsored agency or corporation rather than by the government directly
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: implicit full faith credit bond
synonyms: implicit full faith and credit bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond whose income may vary over time, because either the coupon rate or principal amount is related to a specific index, such as the Consumer Price Index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: index-linked bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond indexed to inflation so that the principal or interest payments rise and fall with the rate of inflation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: inflation-linked bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheduled date of the last regular coupon payment, that is the last of the payments that are made according to a regular repeating series of coupon periods, before any non-standard (long or short) final coupon period in the schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: last regular coupon date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that may be traded on an exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: listed bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: call allowing the issuer to pay off remaining debt early
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: make whole call

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convertible bond that converts into shares at maturity regardless of the equity price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mandatory convertible bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued over time under a shelf registration program, where each issue may have a different coupon and maturity typically ranging from one to ten years
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: medium term note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: government bond that may be issued by a regional, rather than national, authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: official statement specifying how the funds raised via a new issue of municipal securities are to be applied
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal debt funds usage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipal securities dealer responsible for reselling to investors securities (such as variable rate demand obligations and other tender option bonds) that have been tendered for purchase by their owner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal debt remarketing agent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: official statement identifying the source of funds for a new issue of municipal securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal debt source of funds

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short-term obligation to repay a specified principal amount on a certain date, together with interest at a stated rate, usually payable from a defined source of anticipated revenues
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt obligation issued by a regional governmental entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution with trust powers, designated by the issuer, that acts, pursuant to a bond contract, in a fiduciary capacity for the benefit of the bondholders in enforcing the terms of the bond contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal trustee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interest-bearing bond issued at a deep discount to face value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: original issue discount bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: call of part of an issue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partial call

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: call feature whereby the issuer can recall part of the issue on scheduled dates, where bonds are selected to be called according to some rule, or by selecting various bonds at random
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partial call feature

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention used to determine how the partial call will be actioned with respect to bond selection
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partial redemption allocation convention

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that has no maturity date, i.e., one that pays interest in perpetuity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: perpetual bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basis for a percentage quoted rate as used in specifying bond call percentage amounts
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rate basis convention

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: repayment event involving payment of a bond's principal amount at maturity or when it is called
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redemption payment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: repayment schedule whereby a given percentage of a bond issue is redeemed on predefined dates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redemption schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: call triggered by some regulation-specific rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regulatory call

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate bond program where the coupon rate on outstanding bonds is periodically reset through an auction process
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: remarketable bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipal bond supported by the revenue from a specific project
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: revenue bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that is backed by collateral, such as a tangible asset or income stream, in addition to a general promise to pay
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: secured bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms for the paydown of principal in a sinking fund type of amortizing security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sinking fund amortization terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued by the government of a country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sovereign bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt security issued by the government of a country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sovereign debt instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipal bond used to fund a development project that is payable from the revenues of an assessment (tax) on the community that is intended to benefit from the project
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: special assessment bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond secured by a limited revenue source, such as receipts derived from a designated project
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: special obligation bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond secured by revenues derived from designated taxes other than ad valorem taxes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: special tax bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond with a coupon that increases (steps up) while the bond is outstanding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: step up bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: coupon payment terms for securities with a coupon that increases (steps up) while the bond is outstanding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: stepped coupon terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that is part of a series of bonds formed by selling each interest payment and the principal amount of a bond as separate zero coupon bonds.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: strip bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond payable from the incremental increase in tax revenues realized from any increase in property value and other economic activity, often designed to capture the economic benefit resulting from a bond financing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tax allocation bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short-term zero coupon treasury obligation with a maturity ranging from one to twelve months
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: treasury bill

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: long term term coupon bearing treasury obligation issued in terms of 20 years or 30 years that pays interest every six months until they mature
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: treasury bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: variable income bond whose principal is indexed to inflation or deflation and thus changes over the life of the security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: treasury inflation-protected security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: medium term coupon bearing treasury obligation with original maturity ranging from two to ten years
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: treasury note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt instrument issued by HM Treasury and listed on the London Stock Exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: U.K. Government security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt instrument issued by the United States Department of the Treasury that carries a full faith and credit guarantee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: U.S. Treasury security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that is traded over the counter rather than via an exchange or other listing facility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unlisted bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that is only secured by the bond issuer's good credit standing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unsecured bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that has a floating interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable coupon bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual terms specifying the calculation of the interest rate for a variable coupon bond
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable coupon terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: principal that is defined in relation to some variable and so varies over time, as principal
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable debt principal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond whose income may vary over time, because either the coupon rate or principal amount changes in line with an index or schedule over the life of the security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable income bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formula for the calculation of variable interest
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable interest calculation formula

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an expression used to determine a variable interest payment amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable interest expression

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond whose principal adjusts over time with changes in an index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable principal bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued with a coupon rate of zero and that trades at a deep discount to face value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: zero coupon bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms for payment of interest on a zero coupon bond
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: zero coupon terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an event associated with the call schedule for a debt instrument
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: redemption provision defining the rights of the issuer to buy back a security at a call price after a call protection period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call feature

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provision of a call feature defining notification requirements
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call notification provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the price over par paid by an issuer to redeem securities when exercising a call provision
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call premium

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a schedule of call prices and when they are in effect
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an explicit period of time prior to a call date during which an issuer or agent must give notice to holders
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call window

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an offering of one or more debt instruments for sale
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: debt offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: tradeable debt instrument that provides a return in the form of fixed periodic payments and typically the return of principal at maturity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed income security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a variable interest rate that is calculated by adding a margin to a specified index rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fully-indexed interest rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a strip that represents the non-principal portion of the monthly payments on the underlying debt instrument, such as a bond
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest-only strip

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt that is set out by the borrower in some form of financial security in which the lender is the holder or counterparty of that security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: issued debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a call provision allowing the issuer to pay off remaining debt early
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: make whole feature

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a variable that is added to a specified index rate to determine the fully indexed interest rate charged to a borrower on a credit balance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: margin

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a debt instrument that may not be bought or sold
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-tradable debt instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provision of a redemption feature defining notification requirements
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: notification provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event related to the imposition or enforcement of a rule, method, formula, etc.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: prescriptive event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a strip that represents the principal portion of the monthly payments on the underlying debt instrument, such as a bond
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: principal-only strip

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an issued debt in the form of a tradable debt instrument (security)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: publicly issued debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an event associated with the put schedule for a debt instrument, i.e., an event involving the 'put', or surrender of the instrument by the holder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: redemption provision giving the holder the right, but not the obligation, to sell a specified amount of the debt instrument (i.e., redeem it), prior to maturity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put feature

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a provision of a put feature defining notification requirements
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put notification provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an amount over par that a debt instrument holder must pay to sell the security early
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put premium

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a schedule that defines the events associated with the put feature of a debt instrument, i.e, the dates on which the debt instrument may be sold at what price by the holder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an explicit period of time prior to a put date during which holder or agent must give notice to an issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put window

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a prescriptive event involving the return of an investor's principal in a fixed-income security, such as a preferred stock or bond, or the sale of units in a mutual fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redemption event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security price specified in comparison with either a stated or market value for a debt instrument at some point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relative price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event that prescribes a change in a contractual term, such as a rate or notional amount, for a given contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: step event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: schedule specifying the date(s) and change in a contractual term(s), e.g., rate or notional amount, for a contract that has a feature where stipulated changes occur at specified intervals or on specified dates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: step schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a tradeable debt instrument created either through the process of removing coupons from a bond and then selling the separate parts as a zero coupon bond and an interest paying coupon bond or through taking the opposite position from some variant in the options market
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: strip
synonyms: Separate Trading of Registered Interest and Principal of Securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a debt instrument that is also a security, i.e., that can be bought and sold by the holder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tradable debt instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: tradeable debt instrument that provide their owners with a rate of return that is dynamic and determined by market forces
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable income security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of a financial institution (often one of the primary lenders in the syndicate) designated to act as an intermediary between the borrowers and the syndicate lenders
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: administrative agent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution (typically a commercial or investment bank) responsible for coordinating the arrangement, structuring, and marketing of the loan to potential lenders
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bookrunner

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution designated to oversee the drafting, negotiation, and finalization of the loan documentation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: documentation agent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: group of financial institutions or lenders that collectively agree to provide funding for a large loan to a single borrower
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: finance syndicate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: syndicate member that is a financial services provider that contributes funds to a syndicated loan or loan participation note
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: finance syndicate member

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution that spearheads the loan structuring and syndication process on behalf of the borrower
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lead arranger

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: credit facility and fixed-income security that may be distributed across a group of lenders
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan participation note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: credit agreement in which a group of lenders, known as a syndicate, collectively provides a large loan to a single borrower
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: syndicated loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution (typically a commercial or investment bank) designated to help structure, arrange, and manage the loan syndication process
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: syndication agent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exercise terms that stipulate that an option may be exercised on or before the date of expiration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American exercise terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exercise terms that stipulate that an option may only be exercised on predetermined dates within some exercise window, often on one day each month or at the date of expiration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Bermudan exercise terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exercise terms that stipulate that an option may only be exercised on predetermined dates until the first step is reached, but not after that point
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: canary exercise terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exercise terms that stipulate that an option may only be exercised at the date of expiration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: European exercise terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention that determines when the holder or future holder of an option can implement the rights defined in the option
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exercise convention

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract terms specific to the conditions, conventions and other stipulations related to the exercise of an option or entitlement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exercise terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the monthly rate of loan prepayments as a percentage of the original pool balance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: absolute prepayment rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt instrument backed by receivables other than those arising out of real estate loans or mortgages
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: asset-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: lower tranche boundary of a tranche defined as a percentage of the value of the total pool of collateral, either at issuance or as of some point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: attachment point

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: qualified measure of some aspect of the behavior of one or more debt instrument(s) that may vary over time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: debt pool statistical measure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: qualified measure of the rate at which holders of the debt instruments in the pool default on those instruments
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: default rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: upper tranche boundary of a tranche defined as a percentage of the value of the total pool of collateral, either at issuance or as of some point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: detachment point

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt instrument that derives its cashflow from an underlying pool of mortgage loans or other receivables
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pool-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: estimated rate at which a debt or part of a debt is paid off ahead of schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: prepayment speed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured finance that offers investors exposure to chosen underlying assets using various approaches and asymmetric pay-off profiles
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: principal protected note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: estimated per-month percentage of mortgages in an MBS pool that will be paid off early
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: single monthly mortality

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pool-backed security wherein the risk associated with the pool has been uncoupled from the risk associated with the originating institution through a special purpose vehicle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: structured finance instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured finance that is a short-term note linked to an underlying asset that offers a steady stream of income
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: structured finance without principal protection

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: segment of a pool of securities, typically debt instruments
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tranche

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighted-average gross interest rates of the pool of mortgages that underlie a mortgage-backed security (MBS) weighed by their balances at the time the securities were issued
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average coupon

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighted average of the times of the principal repayments Average life is calculated using the weighted average time to the receipt of all future cash flows.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average life

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: dollar-weighted average measuring the age of the individual loans in a mortgage pass-through or pooled security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average loan age

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighted average amount of time until the maturities on mortgages in a mortgage-backed security (MBS)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighted average time to maturity of a portfolio of asset-backed securities (ABS) or mortgage-backed (MBS) securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average remaining term

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short-term debt instrument that is guaranteed and paid by a bank and used as a relatively safe form of payment for large transactions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bankers' acceptance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short-term negotiable financial instrument consisting of an order in writing addressed by one person (the seller of goods) to another (the buyer), requiring the latter to pay a fixed amount of money on demand (a sight draft) or on a predetermined date (a time draft)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bill of exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an unsecured short-term debt instrument typically issued by a bank, corporation, or foreign government to obtain funds to meet short-term debt obligations, such as accounts receivable, inventories, or payroll, backed only by an issuing bank or company promise to pay the face amount on the maturity date specified on the note
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commercial paper

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is required to pay the amount stated on the bill of exchange to the payee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: drawee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that requires a drawee to pay either a third party or themselves with respect to a bill of exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: drawer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a certificate of deposit with a fixed interest rate issued in U.S. dollars outside the jurisdiction of the Federal Reserve, held at banks outside of the United States, including branches of U.S. banks located outside of the U.S.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: eurodollar deposit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a short-term debt security that gives the owner the unconditional right to receive a stated, fixed sum of money on a specified date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: money market instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: agreement between two parties whereby one party lends the other a security at a specified price with a commitment to take the security back at a later date for another specified price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: repurchase agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: depositary receipt that represents securities of a foreign company and allows that company's securities to trade in the U.S. financial markets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American depositary receipt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for American depositary receipts that categorizes ADRs into levels based on the extent to which the foreign company has access to the U.S. market
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American depositary receipt level

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for American depositary receipts that categorizes ADRs into levels based on the extent to which the foreign company has access to the U.S. market
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American depositary receipt level scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: global depositary receipt that represents ownership in the securities of a non-Chinese company that trades on a public exchange in China
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Chinese depositary receipt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: negotiable financial instrument issued by a trust company, security depositary, or bank that is evidence of the deposit of publicly traded securities and that facilitates the ownership of securities traded in other jurisdictions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: depositary receipt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: global depositary receipt that represents ownership in the securities of a non-European company that trades in European financial markets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: European depositary receipt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: dividend that is paid to shareholders periodically

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share whose payment status indicates that only a portion of the market value has been received by the company for the shares
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partially paid share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share that, in addition to paying a stipulated dividend, gives the holder the right to participate with common share holders in additional distributions of earnings under specified conditions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: participating preferred share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share that has no fixed maturity date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: perpetual preferred share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: right that give the shareholder higher priority with respect to certain pre-defined dividend payments over other shareholders and that pay out first in the case of liquidation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: precedence right

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commitment to distribute a portion of earnings to shareholders, similar to a dividend but often with a fixed payment amount and schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred dividend

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that pays dividends at a specified rate and has preference over common shares in the payment of dividends and liquidation of corporate assets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share whose dividend rate varies according to some benchmark
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share with adjustable rate dividend

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share whose dividend rate is periodically reset through an auction, such as a Dutch auction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share with auction rate dividend

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share whose maturity date is set, typically according to the terms of the prospectus
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share with fixed maturity date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share whose dividends are set, typically according to the terms of the prospectus
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share with fixed rate dividend

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: price for one share of a given security at some point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price per share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share in a security that signifies ownership in an entity that is not publicly traded
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: privately held share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: dividend that falls under capital gains tax rates that are lower than the income tax rates on unqualified (ordinary) dividends
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: qualified dividend

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share that gives the issuer the right to redeem the stock under specified conditions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redeemable preferred share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: redeemable preferred share with a fixed maturity date whose issuer has the option to extend the maturity date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redeemable preferred share with extendable maturity date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: redeemable preferred share whose redemption date can be modified
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redeemable preferred share with extendable redemption date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share whose ownership/transfer/sale is subject to special conditions including country-specific restrictions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: restricted share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that confers less than one vote per share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: restricted voting share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share that gives the owner (shareholder) the right to redeem the stock under specified conditions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: retractable preferred share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: retractable preferred share with a fixed maturity date whose issuer and/or holders have the option to extend the maturity date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: retractable preferred share with extendable maturity date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: retractable preferred share whose redemption date can be modified
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: retractable preferred share with extendable redemption date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial instrument that signifies a unit of equity ownership in a corporation, or a unit of ownership in a mutual fund, or interest in a general or limited partnership, or a unit of ownership in a structured product, such as a real estate investment trust
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: issuer of securities that represent an ownership interest in something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: share issuer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier that specifies the overall payment status for shares issued
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: share payment status

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of the annualized dividend per share divided by the (current) price per share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: share yield

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that has the right to exactly one vote
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: single voting share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: retractable preferred share whose retraction value may be paid in cash or in an equal value of common stock of the issuer, at the option of the issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: soft retractable preferred share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: dividend that is paid to shareholders on a one-time basis
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: special dividend

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share whose ownership/transfer/sale is not subject to special conditions including country-specific restrictions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unrestricted share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that certifies ownership of a contractual right to a percentage of a company's profits
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable interest entity share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual right that specifies shareholder voting entitlements, such as to elect directors, elect outside auditors, and vote on matters of corporate policy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: voting right

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: community investment fund that raises capital publicly from community members and deploys some of that capital via investments into its client businesses or other businesses in the community
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: aligned community investment fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that has a fixed number of shares offered by an investment company through an initial public offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: closed-end investment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: professionally-managed investment fund with three essential characteristics: capital is sourced from people in the community (ideally from retail/non-accredited investors); capital is invested into local people, projects, and businesses; and capital is deployed by individuals in the community, typically but not necessarily a nonprofit fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: community investment fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: community investment fund that invests primarily in real estate but can also invest in any local business or project, and can do so with investment capital raised publicly from within the fund's own community, including community investors
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: diversified community investment fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund whose fund units are traded on an exchange, much like stocks
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange-traded fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of the party responsible for managing the operational, accounting, and compliance functions of an investment fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund administrator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract that embodies and defines the fund legal form in cases where there is no independent organization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that owns units in or a percentage of and has rights and responsibilities with respect to some fund, provided in exchange for investment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ownership interest in a fund, which may represented by fund units that confer financial rights and governance privileges
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund holding

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of the party responsible for making investment decisions and managing the portfolio of an investment fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund manager

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that invests directly in other investment funds rather than investing in stocks, bonds, and other securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund of funds

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: position in some fund, which may be defined in terms of fund units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund position

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: quantified share of beneficial interest in a pooled fund, representing a proportional claim on the fund's assets, income, or entitlements
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that pursues a total return and is usually open to qualified investors only
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: hedge fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structure of a fund with respect to its legal formation in some jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal fund structure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: open-end professionally managed investment fund established for the purpose of investing in securities such as stocks, bonds, money market instruments and similar assets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mutual fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security representing an interest in a fund that cannot be traded ontside of the fund itself
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-tradable fund unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment vehicle designed to support a nonprofit mission, whose objectives include environmental stewardship and/or social responsibility in addition to financial performance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: nonprofit fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that offered through a fund company that sells shares directly to investors
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: open-end investment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: fund established separately from the individual accounts of plan members and maintained to finance pension benefits under one or more pension plans
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pension fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment vehicle that provides loans or other forms of credit to companies, typically outside of the traditional banking system
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private credit fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund used for making investments in various equity (and to a lesser extent debt) securities according to an investment strategy associated with private equity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private equity fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that offers shares/units to the public and invests in real estate directly
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real estate investment trust

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: state-owned investment fund that consists of pools of money derived from a country's reserves
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sovereign wealth fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security representing a tradable interest in a fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tradable fund unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pooled investment vehicle in which investors hold units that represent beneficial ownership in a trust-managed portfolio of assets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unit trust

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pooled investment vehicle in which investors hold units that represent a proportional share of the fund's underlying assets, typically used in pensions or insurance-based products
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unitized fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket composed of market indices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market basket

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: single constituent of a basket of indices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket Of indices constituent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket composed of securities, typically of a particular asset class such as equities or bonds
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket of securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket that has a mix of constituents, including securities and indices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mixed basket

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identified as a component of a basket of securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities basket constituent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: European Union wide securities designation, defined by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), that classifies securities based on the quality of capital underlying the instrument
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Basel III Designation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security for which MiFID reporting is required
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: MiFID regulated security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: state-level securities regulation, designed to protect investors against securities fraud that require issuers to be registered and to disclose details of their offerings
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: blue sky law

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: business recurrence interval convention that is a published rule for defining the date of some auction event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: auction date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: calculated date that is determined via a settlement rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: date returned by settlement date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: calculated date that is determined via a trading rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: date returned by trading date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: calculated date associated with a floating-rate note, also known as a floater or FRN, which is a debt instrument with a variable interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: floating-rate note date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: business day adjustment rule applied to floating-rate note instruments
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: floating-rate note date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trading date rule defined as the last trading day of an Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) 90-Day Bank Accepted Futures and Options product, one Sydney business day preceding the second Friday of the relevant settlement month
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: International Money Market (IMM) Australian Dollar (AUD) trading date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trading date rule defined as the last trading day / expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange (Bourse do Montreal Inc.), three month Bankers' Acceptance Futures (Ticker symbol BAX), the second London banking day prior to the third Wednesday of the contract month
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: International Money Market (IMM) Canadian Dollar (CAD) trading date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trading date rule defined as the last trading day of an Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) New Zealand (NZ) 90-Day Bank Accepted Futures and Options product, the first Wednesday after the ninth day of the relevant settlement month
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: International Money Market (IMM) New Zealand Dollar (NZD) trading date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: settlement date rule as defined in the International Money Market (IMM) settlement dates calendar
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: International Money Market (IMM) settlement date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the end date of a specific calculation period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: scheduled calculation period end event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the start of a specific calculation period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: scheduled calculation period start event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention for determining settlement dates by reference to some jurisdiction or as set by a given exchange or similar venue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: settlement date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention for determining trading dates defined with reference to some trading date calendar published by some trading facility or exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trading date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rule for setting auction dates for US Treasury bills
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: US Treasury bill auction date rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: auction date for US 13 week and 26 week Treasury bills
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: US Treasury bill date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: assets pooled by investors whose share capital remains separate from the assets of the vehicle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: collective investment vehicle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pool consisting of debt instruments, such as bonds, loans or mortgages
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: debt pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: collection of managed investments that are all managed by a single investment institution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund family

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pool consisting of financial instruments that may be included in the same investment vehicle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: instrument pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial asset in the form of an instrument pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: instrument pool as asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment pool that is controlled by a professional investment manager who invests the pool in various financial instruments and assets that align with their investment objectives and is overseen by a board of directors
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: managed investment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: combination of resources for a common purpose or benefit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: component of a pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pool constituent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: fund comprising assets combined and managed for a common investment purpose
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pooled fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: managed investment that cannot offer securities to the public
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pool of securities organized for the purpose of issuing notes against those securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial instrument classifier for a group of securities that exhibit similar characteristics, behave similarly in the marketplace and are subject to the same laws and regulations
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: asset class

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classification scheme for set of codes for financial instruments that can be used globally for straight-through processing by all involved participants in an electronic data processing environment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: classification of financial instruments code scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier and code for a financial instrument defined in the ISO 10962 Classification of Financial Instruments (CFI) Code Scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument classification code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classification scheme defining a set of classifiers for financial instruments
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument classification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for a financial instrument based on its type and features
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument classifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: four-tiered standardized classification or delineation for an organization based on the principal business activity of the organization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Global Industry Classification Standards classifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: standardized classification or delineation for an organization based on their main source of revenue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: industry classification benchmark classifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of financial instrument identifiers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identifier that is defined as specified in ISO 6166, Securities and related financial instruments -- International securities identification numbering system (ISIN)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: international securities identification number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal definition of the structure and application of a ISINs as defined in ISO 6166
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: international securities identification numbering scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identifier issued in the public domain and referred to in listings and other relevant publications
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: listed security identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registration authority responsible for issuing and managing National Securities Identifying Numbers for securities in accordance with the ISO 6166 standard in some jurisdiction (typically that of a country)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national numbering agency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: generic, nine-digit alpha numeric code which identifies a fungible security, assigned by a national numbering agency under the ISO 6166 standard
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: National Securities Identifying Number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registry used by a national numbering agency to manage the financial instrument identifiers and related information that it registers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: National Securities Identifying Number registry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a National Securities Identifying Number registry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national numbering agency registry entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identification scheme, defining the format and structure of a National Securities Identifying Number (NSIN), published nationally on behalf of a country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national security identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identification scheme published by a commercial entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: proprietary security identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier supplied by a commercial entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: proprietary security identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of securities identifiers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any publicly available identifier that is used to identify a security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registry used to manage security identifiers and related information
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security registry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: record for a security in a securities registry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security registry entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reassignable identifier of relatively short character string length that is unique within an exchange for a particular financial instrument or listing for that instrument
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ticker symbol

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: 9-character alphanumeric identifier that employs the same 9 characters as CUSIP, but also contains a letter of the alphabet in the first position signifying the issuer's country or geographic region, issued by CUSIP Global Services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CUSIP International Numbering System (CINS) number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nine-character alphanumeric number that identifies all North American stocks and registered bonds for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades, issued by CUSIP Global Services on behalf of the American Bankers' Association, which is a part of Standard and Poor's Capital IQ, that is the National Numbering Agency Identifier for securities issued in North America, which is also part of the ISIN for the security it identifies
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a common code registry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: common code registry entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nine-character alphanumeric securities identifier, issued in Luxembourg, jointly by Euroclear and Clearstream
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Euroclear Clearstream common code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial instrument identifier that is defined as specified in the Object Management Group (OMG) Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) Specification
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument global identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) registry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) registry entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: proprietary code for financial instruments and indices owned, managed, and distributed by the London Stock Exchange Group's LSEG Financial Solutions (branded as Refinitiv)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Refinitiv instrument code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: seven-character security identifier, issued by the London Stock Exchange, that is the National Securities Identifying Number (NSIN) for securities issued in the United Kingdom, which is also part of the ISIN for the security it identifies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has sub-fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the fund is an open-end/closed-end fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is open ended

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates that the fund does not offer its securities to the general public
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is private

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a pooled fund to a parent fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is sub-fund of

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the upper limit on the number of free float shares to be reported, if applicable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has upper limit on floating shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether reporting on the security is required by the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is MiFID reporting required

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the security conforms to the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) of 1974, a federal outline for regulating employee benefit plans, including healthcare plans sponsored and/or insured by an employer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is Employee Retirement Income Security Act conformant

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the security is covered by Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation insured

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether a given cash or margin account is subject to Federal Reserve Board (FRB) margin requirements
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is subject to Federal Reserve Board Regulation T

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which an offering or transaction officially closes, in contrast with an intended closing date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has actual closing date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the first day the public will receive information regarding a new security issue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has announcement date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a security to its ISO 18774-compliant short name, which includes an issuer short name, abbreviated instrument characteristics, and abbreviated instrument description per the ISO standard
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has financial instrument short name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which a newly issued security starts trading
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has first trade date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which the first trade of a newly issued security is settled
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has first trade settlement date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a financial instrument or FISN to an ISO 18774-compliant instrument description, that is, a collection of characteristics and attributes defining a financial instrument with a maximum length up to 19 alphanumeric characters
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has instrument description

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a security issuer or FISN to an ISO 18774-compliant issuer short name, that is, an abbreviation of the official issuer name, limited to a maximum of 15 alphanumeric characters
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has issuer short name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the series identified by the issuer in the event that the instrument is issued in several series (also known as tranches)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has series

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a number of shares or units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has subscription amount

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a period of time in which investors can commit to purchase shares (or units) to be issued
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has subscription period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the form in which the security is issued, typically in registered form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is issued in form

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether or not the subscription is over-subscribed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is over-allotted

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the registration authority for a given security, i.e., in the name of the owner on the books of the issuer, with the issuer's registrar, with a third-party transfer agent, with a broker-dealer, or other competent party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is registered

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an offering to an underwriter involved in raising capital for or distributing the instruments that are the subject of the offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is underwritten by

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a security that will replace a convertible security under the terms of the agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: specifies conversion into

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies one or more underwriters involved in raising capital for or distributing the instruments that are the subject of the offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwrites

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the date set by the exchange for delisting a security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has delisting date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the exchange that is considered the primary market for a security; typically, but not always, in the country in which the security was originally issued
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has home exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the last date and time that the security was traded on the exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has last trading date and time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which a security is listed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has listing date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the original exchange that listed the security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has original place of listing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a minimum price movement for the security with respect to an exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has tick size

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the service responsible for listing the security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is listed via

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates that the security has been publicly traded long enough to eliminate any short-term volume volatility from its initial public offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is seasoned

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the trading facility on which the security is traded
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is traded on

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a given exchange-specific security listing to its issue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lists

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies a holding period applicable to some financial asset
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has holding period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies a restriction applicable to a given financial instrument or listing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has restriction
